description: Check Cedar authorization policies (the language of AWS Verified Permissions) with the official Cedar engine, instead of reasoning about them: parse errors with their location; validation against your schema if you give one (wrong attribute, wrong entity type, impossible conditions); and, for each request, allow or deny with the policies that decided it — so you can tell a missing permit from a forbid that wins, and see a forbid that errored and so did not apply (fails open). Policies may carry @id("…") to name them in the answer.

entities.description: Entities in Cedar JSON format: {uid:{type,id}, attrs, parents}

principal.description: Entity UID in Cedar syntax, e.g. User::"alice"

schema.description: Cedar schema, text or JSON. If given, policies are validated against it

name: cedar_check
